lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits, displaying increasing inter-centroid distance along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like arrangement on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges running longitudinally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of approximately 12 high-luminance blobs bounded within the visible macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notches and loss of tissue along the trailing (posterior) edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately five commensal remora fish positioned along the ventral profile and pelvic region of the shark.
